description: One row per lap of an activity, plus one row per interval rep when it was an interval session: distance, time, pace and grade-adjusted pace, heart rate, power, cadence, running dynamics, elevation, calories, temperature and respiration. For questions like "how did each rep go?" or "which kilometres were slowest?". Location is never returned. Get the activity id from garmin_search_activities. On the Cloudflare free plan a long activity can fail with a connector error (CPU limit): say so rather than retrying.
name: garmin_get_activity_laps
title: Get Garmin activity laps
